eligible_predicate: for tiktok_shop_verified: verified_purchase == true AND identity_noise == none

experience_cohort.predicate: product_match in {exact_current_family, category_adjacent} AND experience_scope in {full, partial} AND text non-empty
experience_cohort.note: Consumers must not filter on experience_scope alone; off-target evaluations exist and never enter a product claim.

frame_denominators.tiktok_shop_verified: eligible verified-purchase canonical reviews in the 2026-07-01..2026-10-29 window; one direction per record; never compared with natural or diagnostic percentages

video_layer.population: unique videos from keyword search with a high/medium product relation
video_layer.denominator: 48 baseline-eligible videos; not a probability sample
video_layer.not_mergeable_with: tiktok_shop_verified reviews: review_id is the unit and no video join key exists
video_layer.support_gate: layer n>=8 AND bootstrap 95% CI excludes 1 AND sensitivity group n>=8
